invariants.rationale: It is typical for method entry to expect the input list is not null, as null inputs may lead to NullPointerExceptions in method logic.
List.size() is always non-negative, so if the list is empty or not, its size is >= 0.
It is often expected that collections of records do not contain null elements; this is a likely invariant at method entry.
If the list is empty, its size is 0.
